Litera develops legal technology software for law firms and legal professionals. The Associate Software Engineer builds and enhances secure, reliable, and scalable cloud-based products, collaborating with Product, UX, and Quality Engineering teams and using AI-powered development tools to deliver customer-focused capabilities.

Greater application stability, performance, and reliability through identifying issues and implementing effective solutions
Impactful product capabilities built in partnership with Product, UX, and Quality Engineering teams to meet customer and business needs
Improved code quality and maintainability through testing, peer reviews, and engineering best practices
Faster delivery and streamlined engineering workflows through AI-powered development tools
Scalable cloud-based applications and services that support a global customer base
Continued growth in technical expertise across modern frameworks, cloud platforms, and emerging AI technologies, while contributing as an engaged member of an Agile team

Strong problem-solving, analytical, and critical-thinking skills with attention to detail
Strong communication skills, a growth mindset, and enthusiasm for learning new technologies in an AI-first engineering environment
Bachelor's degree in Computer Science, Software Engineering, or a related technical field, or equivalent practical experience
Preferred
Exposure to full-stack web development using .NET/C#, REST APIs, or similar modern application frameworks
Familiarity with cloud platforms such as AWS or Azure
Experience using AI-powered development tools such as Cursor, GitHub Copilot, or similar coding assistants
Familiarity with Agile development practices, legal technology, data analytics, AI/ML applications, or experience in fast-paced environments through projects, open-source work, or hackathons

Hybrid role based in Denver, CO, with at least 3 days a week in the office.
A collaborative, supportive team that leads with integrity.
Meaningful stretch opportunities, visibility, and career development.
Eligible to participate in a company bonus plan.
Medical, dental, and vision coverage.
